steps.tx: Pyrimidines invert purine logic: build the base first from **carbamoyl phosphate** (cytosolic CPS II, glutamine plus bicarbonate, UTP feedback inhibited, S phase growth activated) plus aspartate (transcarbamoylase, bacterial ATCase allosteric prototype), close the ring, oxidise to orotate, then attach PRPP ribose (orotate phosphoribosyltransferase) and decarboxylate to UMP, the parent of UDP/UTP and CTP (UTP aminated by glutamine, ATP). Compartment separation (CPS II cytosol pyrimidines versus CPS I mitochondria urea) prevents nitrogen cross talk and examines relentlessly.
steps.say: Pyrimidines build base first from cytosolic carbamoyl phosphate plus aspartate, then attach ribose to orotate. Compartment separation from mitochondrial urea CPS one examines relentlessly across modules historically.

steps.tx: **Thymidylate synthase** methylates dUMP to dTMP with N5,N10-methylene THF (oxidised to dihydrofolate, uniquely consuming folate redox, regenerated by dihydrofolate reductase), making DNA thymine the folate dependent step behind methotrexate, pemetrexed and 5-fluorouracil (FdUMP ternary suicide complex, leucovorin paradoxically potentiating fluoropyrimidines while rescuing methotrexate normal cells by timing). Ribonucleotide reductase supplies all deoxy diphosphates upstream (next lesson), dUTPase prevents uracil DNA incorporation, and thymidine kinase salvage surges in S phase (viral TK activating acyclovir selectively).
steps.say: Thymidylate synthase consumes folate redox uniquely, making it the methotrexate and fluorouracil target together. Leucovorin potentiates fluoropyrimidines while rescuing methotrexate by timing differences pharmacologically.

steps.tx: Hereditary **orotic aciduria** (UMP synthase bifunctional orotate transferase/decarboxylase failure, autosomal recessive) excretes massive orotate with megaloblastic anaemia unresponsive to B12 and folate, failure to thrive and developmental delay, but crucially normal ammonia (versus OTC deficiency hyperammonaemia with orotate from carbamoyl spill). Oral uridine (bypassing block to UMP, feedback suppressing CPS II overdrive) cures blood and growth dramatically, one of metabolic medicines cleanest replacement logics, now uridine triacetate prodrug availability.
steps.say: Hereditary orotic aciduria gives megaloblastic anaemia with normal ammonia, separating it from OTC deficiency. Oral uridine bypasses the block and cures blood and growth dramatically and cleanly.

steps.tx: Pyrimidine degradation dissolves bases to soluble products (dihydrouracil, beta-alanine from uracil, beta-aminoisobutyrate from thymine, ammonia and CO2) without an insoluble urate equivalent, explaining no pyrimidine gout; **dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase** (DPD, DPYD genetics) catabolises 5-fluorouracil, whose deficiency (partial in three to five percent, complete rare) causes lethal fluoropyrimidine toxicity (mucositis, marrow, neurology, cardiac) now pre screened in many systems with dose adaptation or avoidance, pharmacogenetics directly preventing deaths.
steps.say: Pyrimidine degradation dissolves to soluble products without gout equivalents. DPD deficiency causes lethal fluorouracil toxicity now pre screened genetically with dose adaptation preventing deaths in oncology practice.

steps.tx: **Beta-alanine** products feed pantothenate adjacency and methylmalonate semialdehyde trivia respectively, while cytidine deaminase and deoxycytidine kinase govern cytarabine (ara-C) activation and inactivation in leukaemia therapy (gemcitabine deamination resistance design). Salvage thymidine kinase 1 S phase and mitochondrial TK2 (myopathy depletion syndromes when mutant) split cytosolic proliferation from mitochondrial maintenance, bridging to mitochondrial DNA disease already met in oxidation.
steps.say: Cytidine enzymes govern cytarabine leukaemia therapy activation and resistance design pharmacologically. Mitochondrial thymidine kinase failure depletes mitochondrial DNA, bridging to mitochondrial disease already met in oxidation modules.

steps.tx: **Antimetabolite synthesis** unifies the module: block folate regeneration (methotrexate) and both purine atoms and thymidylate starve; block thymidylate directly (fluoropyrimidines) and DNA alone starves (thymineless death); block reductase (hydroxyurea next lesson) and all deoxy nucleotides starve; supply uridine and orotic block bypasses. Every stem naming one drug expects the other three contrasts in reserve, which DNA replication machinery next converts into S phase vulnerability windows.
steps.say: Block folate, thymidylate or reductase and DNA starves by distinguishable widths therapeutically. Supply uridine and orotic blocks bypass cleanly. DNA replication machinery next converts these into vulnerability windows.
